title: ulei.toml
description: C9 (draft): every section and key of `ulei.toml`, the one config file of the daemons (ADR-0040). A document is the file parsed as TOML. Every section is closed; every key is one of five kinds: `string`, `integer`, `boolean`, `["integer", "string"]` for a value the subset can only write as text, and `["boolean", "integer", "string"]` for a switch. An item section maps a name to its keys. There is no key for a secret value: secrets stay in the files the `*_file` keys name. No key is required by the schema; each binary requires the keys it reads.

web_store.description: Directory of the full texts of truncated pages.

stall_guards.description: Switch of the identical-call notice and stub.

mcp_servers.description: Comma-separated names of the MCP servers, each configured under `engine.mcp.<name>`.

enabled.description: Switch of the early end of empty-reply retries.

no_ask_guard.description: The `no-ask-guard` policy, on when `route` is set.

note_file.description: The file of the continuation note.

instructions_file.description: The file of the classifier instructions.

log.description: The JSON-lines file of the guard's records.

routes.description: One item section per route alias.

warnings_enabled.description: Switch of the warnings appended to tool results.

hard_stop_enabled.description: Switch of blocked calls and halted turns.

max_web_searches.description: `web_search` calls of one turn; 0 is no limit.

mcp.description: One item section per MCP server that `engine.mcp_servers` lists.

socket.description: The C4G socket of the gateway.

token_file.description: The file holding the bot token, mode 0600.

owner_ids.description: Owner user ids: an integer or comma-separated integers.

engine_connect_timeout.description: Seconds of a connect to the C6 socket.

engine_call_timeout.description: Seconds of a whole C6 call.

base_url.description: Base URL of the Bot API.

file_base_url.description: Base URL of Bot API file downloads.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds of a connect to the Bot API.

read_timeout.description: Seconds of a read from the Bot API.

write_timeout.description: Seconds of each write of a request body.

poll_timeout.description: Whole seconds of a long poll.

coalesce_quiet.description: Quiet window of the turn coalescer in seconds.

coalesce_max.description: Cap of a coalesced turn in seconds.

stt_env_file.description: The env-file holding the speech-to-text key; set, voice notes are transcribed.

stt_base_url.description: Base URL of the speech-to-text endpoint.

stt_echo_transcripts.description: Whether each voice transcript is echoed to the owner; default true.

reaction_wake_delay.description: Seconds from the first owner reaction to the wake-up turn.

reaction_context_header.description: First line of the reaction context.

redact_secrets.description: Switch of the redaction of secrets in tool output; default on.

garden.description: The garden daemon, `ulei-garden serve`; it also reads `inbox.socket`.

store.description: The SQLite file of the store; `serve` requires it.

socket.description: The C7 socket, at most 107 bytes; `serve` requires it.

producer_key_file.description: The 32-byte C1 producer key the garden signs `garden_miss` with, owner-only; `serve` requires it.

domains_file.description: JSON of the starting domains, replacing the built-in list as the seed.

core_file.description: The rendered pinned core profile; unset, no render.

core_char_limit.description: Characters of the core profile; default 1375.

reranker.description: The reranker; only `none`, the default, is accepted.

second_level.description: The second-level provider of a miss; only `none`, the default, is accepted.

min_confidence.description: Least proposer confidence the edge accepts on its own, a decimal; default `"0.6"`.

reconcile_min_cosine.description: Least cosine at which a new fact and a current fact of the same entity are reconciled, a decimal; default `"0.85"`.

search_k.description: Facts of a `search` without `k`, 1 to 50; default 5.

pointer_min_cosine.description: Least cosine of a pointer, a decimal; default `"0.5"`.

pointer_min_lexical.description: Least lexical score of a pointer, a decimal; default `"5.0"`.

enabled.description: Run the model in the helper; a helper that does not get ready stops the start; default false.

helper.description: The `ulei-garden-embed` binary; `serve` requires it when enabled.

model_dir.description: Directory of `onnx/model_quantized.onnx` and `tokenizer.json`; `serve` requires it when enabled.

ort_library.description: `libonnxruntime.so` of an official Linux x64 CPU release; `serve` requires it when enabled.

threads.description: Intra-op threads of the helper; default 2.

load_timeout.description: Seconds `serve` waits for the helper's ready line at start; default 120.

ttl.description: `[garden.ttl]`: lifetime of a fact per C7 `TtlKind`, seconds above 0 or `"never"`; `never_cache` has no key.

expire_interval.description: Least seconds between two expiry passes; default 60.

recheck_interval.description: Least seconds between two recheck batches; default 3600.

recheck_batch.description: Rechecks handed to the second level per batch; default 8.

maintain_interval.description: Seconds between two maintenance passes; default 604800.

Route.description: `[engine.routes.<alias>]`: the window of one route alias.

max_tokens.description: Output tokens a step may take.

idempotent_no_progress.description: Identical results of one read-only call.

url.description: The `http://` URL of the server on a loopback host.

env_file.description: The env-file of the request headers.

connect_timeout.description: Seconds of the connect and the tool listing.

tools.description: `[engine.mcp.<name>.tools]`: which tools of the server are registered.

include.description: Comma-separated tool names or globs; unset, all.
